<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="yakamaru" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Yakamaru</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/NhlRG0hm04.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Yakamaru is the second boss in the Liberation of Mazcab raid, with up to 10 players in a single encounter. While the fight itself does have many mechanics and sections that require coordination between players, with just a little knowledge and practice and communication between your teammates, it can become a relatively smooth and fun boss encounter.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This guide aims to cover the basic mechanics of Yakamaru, and cover some of strategies, tips and tricks that will help you get your first kills and beyond. As this is a mechanically intensive group fight with a longer guide, it is broken into a few sections (all linked in the Table of Contents) for easier navigation:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ To see what roles there are and what each one does, see </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Roles at Yakamaru</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ To learn about Yakamaru's attacks and pool mechanics, see </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Auto Attacks</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>, </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Special Attacks</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> and </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Pool Mechanics</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ See </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Fight Overview</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> for a brief description of the fight, and </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Fight Phases</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> for more in-depth information.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="drop-rates"><ins><nowiki>Drop Rates</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong>[https://www.runescape.com/drop-rates <nowiki>Click here</nowiki>]</strong><nowiki> to see how drop rates for Raids uniques are calculated (scroll down to </nowiki><em><nowiki>Liberation of Mazcab</nowiki></em><nowiki>).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Given that Yakamaru is a fairly advanced boss and that its a </nowiki><em><nowiki>group boss</nowiki></em><nowiki>, it is reasonable (and ideal) to have a sufficient level of gear before attempting the boss. </nowiki><strong><nowiki>This helps both make the fight easier and make it easier for you to get into teams.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>A guideline set of recommendations might this include:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ T80+ power armour + T90+ weapons, perked with </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Starter Perks</nowiki></strong><nowiki> from </nowiki><span><nowiki>#perks</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 95+ Prayer </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for curses </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1" alt="turmoil" title="turmoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936665198592.png?v=1" alt="anguish" title="anguish" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1" alt="torment" title="torment" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 99+ Herblore </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554435583508558.png?v=1" alt="Herblore" title="Herblore" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for overloads </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554436179361864.png?v=1" alt="ovl" title="ovl" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1" alt="elderovlsalve" title="elderovlsalve" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Berserker auras </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505116347105290.png?v=1" alt="berserker" title="berserker" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505179378974748.png?v=1" alt="reckless" title="reckless" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505153709965322.png?v=1" alt="mani" title="mani" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>As always, feel free to adjust the presets according to what you have available.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=yk1Gpp9iDn0X0xX21oSQ <nowiki>Magic | Basic DPS / Free</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/f5f02637b61fa830cf194c3b6da825cd6705dd9f214f6b170468571881b5fc04.webp" alt="Yakamaru Basic Mage" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=SZME3sjYOMDBby7M6LGA <nowiki>Melee | Basic DPS / Free</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/cecb7546de7f6cf9f401455fed015fc6857ce1ba3c2f6135ec8694155170e607.webp" alt="Yakamaru Basic Melee" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=i5WO2DTuiWD1z0BNGMK9 <nowiki>Ranged | Basic DPS / Free</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/3c8390de5a1796b3669f304ecfb0b8300629543982dbe4d8bcdcda2402a2722b.webp" alt="Yakamaru Range Entry Level" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=0qcPZuWuWeO2UqVkKHy4 <nowiki>Magic | Tank</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>​
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F0qcPZuWuWeO2UqVkKHy4.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="standard-preset-notes"><nowiki>Standard Preset Notes</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Prefer a DPS familiar</nowiki></strong><nowiki> like </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1" alt="ripperpouch" title="ripperpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275155464203.png?v=1" alt="ripperscroll" title="ripperscroll" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226484301925.png?v=1" alt="kalgpouch" title="kalgpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1" alt="kalgscroll" title="kalgscroll" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, but if required, use a Hellhound </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1" alt="hellhoundpouch" title="hellhoundpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/922417969731088435.png?v=1" alt="hellhoundscroll" title="hellhoundscroll" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or Reaver </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903693837959228.png?v=1" alt="reaverpouch" title="reaverpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1022562484378419284.png?v=1" alt="reaverscroll" title="reaverscroll" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for better survivability.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• See </nowiki><code><nowiki>!familiar</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎for more info.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Melee is not very learner-friendly, and without sufficient gear will lack DPS compared to other styles - </nowiki><strong><nowiki>avoid it if you are a learner, or if a low budget.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ As Melee, The Zaros Godsword spec </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626465964325601290.png?v=1" alt="zgs" title="zgs" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used on alternate pools when Berserk </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is on cooldown to increase DPS.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="tank-preset-notes"><nowiki>Tank Preset Notes</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>This preset is built around survivability</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - the most important thing as a tank is to stay alive - a Reaver </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903693837959228.png?v=1" alt="reaverpouch" title="reaverpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1022562484378419284.png?v=1" alt="reaverscroll" title="reaverscroll" kind="icon" /><nowiki> autofiring its scrolls with a short delay can be a significant source of sustain.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Remember to use Prism of Restoration </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/938475261366784070.png?v=1" alt="prismofrestoration" title="prismofrestoration" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to prevent it from dying.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If this is not sufficient, or you have difficulties using it, a BoB </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1499293961364308059.png?v=1" alt="mammothpouch" title="mammothpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be an alternative.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Raids armour </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641344704939819028.png?v=1" alt="achtoprimevaltop" title="achtoprimevaltop" kind="icon" /><nowiki> defensive resets can make tanking a lot easier</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, alternatively Seasingers </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1501858060010913792.png?v=1" alt="supseasingersrobetop" title="supseasingersrobetop" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Ganodermic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1003947805611655208.png?v=1" alt="ganobody" title="ganobody" kind="icon" /><nowiki> etc. will also benefit from using Animate Dead </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1" alt="animatedead" title="animatedead" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if not owned.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Once you are more comfortable tanking, you can switch to power armour and reduce/avoid shield-camping.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="fight-overview"><ins><nowiki>Fight Overview</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Yakamaru is the second boss in Liberation of Mazcab raid, fought after Beastmaster Durzag is killed, and the puzzle section afterwards is completed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>The loot lock can be reset every 2 days at reset (00:00 UTC)</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, but the boss can be fought more often for KC.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This gives no loot, but </nowiki><em><nowiki>does</nowiki></em><nowiki> give chance at pet drops.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Yakamaru fight takes place at the Mazcab beach, where there are 5 pools located.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The arena looks like the following:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/A9OBq6m.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>The fight consists of two phases</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Pools phase</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - Yakamaru jumps between different pools using different mechanics and must be killed in each one.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Mirage phase</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - After killing it once in each pool, Yakamaru spawns in all pools simultaneously and must be killed in all the pools and 'closed' permanently, to finish the fight.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ During the pools phase, there will be a special mechanic for each pool - this is covered in the </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Pool Mechanics</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> section.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Yakamaru attacks with auto attacks (Ranged if out of MD, Magic if in MD) and special attacks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The default attack cycle uses a number of auto attacks followed by a special attack, and then repeats.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The number of autos varies from pool to pool.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>The attack cycle starts at a random point in the cycle</nowiki></em><nowiki> (i.e. Yakamaru could begin with a spec, and then continue from there.)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="roles-at-yakamaru"><ins><nowiki>Roles at Yakamaru</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>As it is a group fight, a number of players are assigned roles to make the encounter smoother and faster. Here we cover what they are and their basic responsibilities.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><u><nowiki>Yakamaru Roles</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>The following roles may be assigned to players at Yakamaru.
Players without a dedicated role are just DPSers.
Roles are roughly sorted by difficulty, for new players.
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Easy Roles</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ CPR
⬥ Stun 0 (ST0)
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Medium Roles</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Jelly Wrangler (JW)
⬥ Stun 5 (ST5)
⬥ Poison Tank (PT)
⬥ Double
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Advanced Roles</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Base Tank
⬥ North Tank (NT)
⬥ Shark 10 (SH10)
⬥ Main Stun (MS)
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><strong><nowiki>Note</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: A single player can have more than 1 role, depending on what roles they take.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="base-tank-base"><nowiki>Base Tank / Base</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Primary tasks</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tank Yakamaru during each pool until Mirage phase.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tank Tendrils pool during Mirage phase until it is dead.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Other tasks</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Avoid standing near other players, allow them to flank the boss.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>Do not die</nowiki></em><nowiki> - prioritise staying alive even at the expense of DPS.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Notable info</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Yakamaru's enrage mechanic affects the base - they will take the most damage during the fight.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This role can help do more DPS on faster teams, or go full tank/shield camp route. This depends on the player and expected killtimes for the team. </nowiki><em><nowiki>If in doubt - focus on surviving.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="poison-tank-pt"><nowiki>Poison Tank / PT</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Primary tasks</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stand on the correct tile and absorb the poison that Yakamaru spawns after each pool reaches 100k HP left.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Move into MD of Yakamaru after absorbing poison, then help defeat the pool.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Notable info</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The tile the poison will land on looks is indicated by </nowiki><em><nowiki>green arrows</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• There is no poison to absorb during Mirage phase - only during the first phase with the 4 pools.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bladed Dive </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> helps get to the poison ASAP, and Barge </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532853916860437.png?v=1" alt="barge" title="barge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used to get into MD quickly and consistently.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Teams will typically assign a </nowiki><em><nowiki>Double</nowiki></em><nowiki> role - if the first pool is </nowiki><em><nowiki>not</nowiki></em><nowiki> Stun pool, then the Double will absorb the poison required for stun pool </nowiki><em><nowiki>during the sand pool's poison</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This is to save time and lower chances of failing poison on Stun pool as it can die very quickly.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If this happens, the Poison Tank only ends up absorbing 3 sets of poison instead of 4.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• After a successful pool, the PT will be washed up on the beach near the south. </nowiki><em><nowiki>The CPR role is expected to revive the player in time</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="north-tank-nt"><nowiki>North Tank / NT</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Primary tasks</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tank Sand pool (and also usually Stun pool) during Mirage phase until the other 3 pools are dead.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Stand </nowiki><em><nowiki>north</nowiki></em><nowiki> of the pool when tanking it.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ To aggro both pools: tag Sand pool, then use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1" alt="voke" title="voke" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on Stun pool.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Notable info</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>Sand pool is almost always the last to die during Mirage phase</nowiki></em><nowiki> - on slower teams, this can be a tank test. Use defensives if you have to.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Jellies may spawn while tanking the pool - dodge them and let the Jelly Wrangler handle them, or freeze/stun them and move away.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="cpr"><nowiki>CPR</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Primary tasks</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Click on the washed-up player on the beach after each pool to prevent them being instakilled.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Notable info</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Once Mirage phase starts, there are no more players to revive.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="double"><nowiki>Double</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Primary tasks</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Absorb poison on the Sand pool and take the place of the Poison Tank during Stun pool instead.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The Double will stand on the same tile as the Poison Tank during the Sand pool to do this.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Notable info</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>Stand in MD of the Stun pool the entire time</nowiki></em><nowiki>. This is because the Stun pool dies very quickly.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Stun pool is the first pool, this role has no responsibilities.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Be sure to bring extra food to compensate for the extra damage taken, </nowiki><em><nowiki>especially on slower teams</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="main-stun"><nowiki>Main Stun</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Primary tasks</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stun Yakamaru </nowiki><em><nowiki>at the appropriate time</nowiki></em><nowiki> during the Stun pool, when his damage reduction is too high.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Notable info</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Do NOT accidentally kill the team by stunning too early or multiple times.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A correctly timed stun will only deal 1000 damage to all players, which can rise up to 5000 damage if stunned too early (stun when Yakamaru's health begins to drop very slowly).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is preferred to use non-channeled abilities to stun.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• On newer/inexperienced teams, a warning that you are about to stun may let players eat up before stunning.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="stun-0-st0"><nowiki>Stun 0 / ST0</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Primary tasks</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• On Mirage phase, help kill the Stun pool first </nowiki><em><nowiki>ASAP</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Then help kill the other pools in order (Shark &gt; Tendrils &gt; Sand).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Notable info</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This role may not always be assigned, especially on more experienced teams where two Stun 5 roles are sufficient.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If a Stun 5 role dies, you can easily take their place.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>Do not randomly use stuns during Mirage phase</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="stun-5-st5"><nowiki>Stun 5 / ST5</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Primary tasks</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Kill the Stun pool </nowiki><em><nowiki>ASAP</nowiki></em><nowiki> after Mirage phase starts and use </nowiki><em><nowiki>5 planks</nowiki></em><nowiki> on it by clicking on the pool.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Then help kill the other pools in order (Shark &gt; Tendrils &gt; Sand).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Notable info</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>Use your strongest abilities to burst the pool down</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pick up your planks </nowiki><em><nowiki>before</nowiki></em><nowiki> Mirage phase starts to make it easier and prevent issues.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>Do not randomly use stuns during Mirage phase</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The pool only needs to be tanked for a short amount of time as it dies quickly.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="shark-10-sh10"><nowiki>Shark 10 / SH10</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Primary tasks</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tank the Shark pool during Mirage phase, and use </nowiki><em><nowiki>10 planks</nowiki></em><nowiki> on it by clicking the pool after it dies.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Notable info</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stand behind the Shark pool to prevent other players from getting enrage stacks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pick up your planks </nowiki><em><nowiki>before</nowiki></em><nowiki> Mirage phase starts to make it easier and prevent issues (area loot can help).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>If inventory space is an issue, ask another player to help with planks when assigning roles</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Be sure to bring extra food to compensate for the extra damage taken, </nowiki><em><nowiki>especially on slower teams</nowiki></em><nowiki>. Defensives </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are useful to mitigate damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Setting up an Ultimate ability </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1" alt="sunshine" title="sunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1" alt="deathsswift" title="deathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> before Mirage phase starts can help make this a lot quicker.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="jelly-wrangler-jw"><nowiki>Jelly Wrangler / JW</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Primary tasks</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>Quickly</nowiki></em><nowiki> tag and aggro all Jellyfish spawned during Mirage phase and keep them away from other players.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Keep Jellyfish alive after tagging them.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Notable info</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>Yakamaru will not attack the Jelly Wrangler if they are attacking Jellies, so praying against Melee </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMelee" title="DeflectMelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> works</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A maximum of 10 Jellyfish may be alive at once, so avoid killing them.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If JW moves too far away, Jellies will lose aggro, so be careful with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use of Ice Barrage </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1" alt="icebarrage" title="icebarrage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or Entangle </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727987274022924.png?v=1" alt="ent" title="ent" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can help, as well as the Provoke </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1" alt="voke" title="voke" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ability to gain aggro.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Keep moving around to avoid being surrounded by jellies. Defensives </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are useful to mitigate damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="auto-attacks"><ins><nowiki>Auto-attacks</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Yakamaru uses </nowiki><strong><nowiki>AoE auto attacks</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, and the attack style changes based on location:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Within halberd range (≤2 tiles)</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Magic attacks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Outside halberd range (≥3 tiles)</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Ranged attacks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Yakamaru has </nowiki><strong><nowiki>100% hitchance on all auto attacks.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Attacks that 'miss' deal 50% damage instead.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Each auto-attack on the primary target (base) applies 1 enrage stack ('Drenched' debuff)</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This also applies to any player within 7 tiles of the base.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Each stack increases damage taken by +20% additively.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Using Freedom </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /><nowiki> halves the number of stacks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="jellyfish"><ins><nowiki>Jellyfish</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Yakamaru spawns Jellyfish of different colours during the fight</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ There are 6 different types of Jellyfish:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Normal/Orange</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: deals melee damage and spawns as part of Yakamaru's 'Jellyfish Spawn' special attack (see </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Special Attacks</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Durable</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: heals other nearby Jellies and Yakamaru while alive.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Magical</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: deals Magic damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Meleefish</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: deals Melee damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Piercing</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: deals Ranged damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Reflecting</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: causes all other Jellies to take less damage, and reflect damage taken onto players - these will die on their own.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Except before Sand Pool and Mirage, first phase Yakamaru in the center pool, </nowiki><em><nowiki>then</nowiki></em><nowiki> kill the colourful jellies.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="special-attacks"><ins><nowiki>Special Attacks</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The following 2 special attacks are generic and common to all pools.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Pool-specific special attacks are covered in the </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Pool Mechanics</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> section.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="jellyfish-spawn"><nowiki>Jellyfish Spawn</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/qdrWMC0.gif" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ Yakamaru spawns one orange jellyfish and 5 'cracks' on the floor.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>The jellyfish should be killed ASAP</nowiki></strong><nowiki> as it deals high AoE melee damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Standing on the cracks will shortly deal 10000 damage to the jellyfish, but also deal 1500-2000 Magic damage to the player.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Defensives </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will mitigate this.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Stuns/binds (like </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1" alt="icebarrage" title="icebarrage" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) are useful here.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="blue"><nowiki>Blue</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/Ncu3Fpt.gif" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ This attack is typically referred to as '</nowiki><strong><nowiki>blue</nowiki></strong><nowiki>'.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ A random player will be turned blue (similar to the Metamorphosis </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533811304497183.png?v=1" alt="meta" title="meta" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ability) and take up to </nowiki><strong><nowiki>4 increasing typeless damage hits</nowiki></strong><nowiki> (1500 → 2500 → 3500 → 4500).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Standing next to someone else will pass the effect to them with no damage taken.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Passing it to other players is the recommended way of dealing with it.</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Otherwise, just spam eat.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: If this occurs during mirage phase, it will deal a </nowiki></em><em><nowiki>single hit of 2000 damage</nowiki></em><em><nowiki>, so avoid panicking and running around should it occur to you.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="pool-mechanics"><ins><nowiki>Pool Mechanics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Here we go over what each pool at Yakamaru does and how to deal with them. Then we cover the actual fight in the </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Fight Phases</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> section.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="tendrils-pool-south-most"><nowiki>Tendrils Pool (south-most)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/l1etI6A.gif" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ Yakamaru gains access to </nowiki><strong><nowiki>two new special attacks</nowiki></strong><nowiki> (both used at the same time):</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Choking Tendrils</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Yakamaru chokes top 5 DPS, dealing increasing damage per tick. </nowiki><em><nowiki>Players must free themselves by doing damage.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Damage Tendrils</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Summons a large pile of tendrils on Yakamaru's current target that hit 2000 damage per tick for several ticks. Players should move away or use Barricade </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / Immort </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538582017.png?v=1" alt="immort" title="immort" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to deal with it.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Attack cycle for this pool is as follows</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 4 autos → Jellyfish → 4 autos → Blue → 4 autos → Tendrils → repeat</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Let the base tag the pool first</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - prevents the Damage Tendrils randomly spawning on the DPS pile.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If poison tank gets choked when poison spawns.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Someone else can get it.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This pool is relatively straightforward - </nowiki><strong><nowiki>just avoid the tendrils</nowiki></strong><nowiki> and it'll go smoothly.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="shark-pool-south-west"><nowiki>Shark Pool (south-west)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/RaWF56G.gif" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ Yakamaru gains access to </nowiki><strong><nowiki>one new special attack</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Sharknado</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Yakamaru spins in a whirlpool and throws out sharks on the floor randomly, which explode for 2k damage </nowiki><em><nowiki>each</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Attack cycle for this pool is as follows</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 4 autos → Jellyfish → 4 autos → Blue → 4 autos → Sharknado → repeat</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Sharks can be clicked to kick them away, or simply move away from them.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>The sharks spawned are blocking</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - be careful of getting stuck!</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The poison tank should be careful and use Barricade </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if necessary, if Sharknado occurs during the last 100k HP.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This can also be helpful when basing or getting hit by multiple sharks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Note that sharks will follow the player while being thrown out - </nowiki><strong><nowiki>move away from the sharks </nowiki><ins><nowiki>after</nowiki></ins><nowiki> they have landed</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ A Jellyfish will spawn</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This pool is relatively straightforward - just avoid the shark spawns and it'll go smoothly.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="sand-pool-north-west"><nowiki>Sand Pool **(north-west)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/NzqhNcQ.gif" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ Yakamaru gains access to </nowiki><strong><nowiki>one new special attack</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Sand</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: All but 1-2 players are 'sanded'/stuck and cannot move. Players not stuck must rescue others by </nowiki><strong><nowiki>clicking on them</nowiki></strong><nowiki>. If not freed in time, they are instakilled.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Attack cycle for this pool is as follows</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 4 autos → Blue → 4 autos → Jelly → 4 autos → Sand → repeat</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Players </nowiki><strong><nowiki>can</nowiki></strong><nowiki> continue to eat, attack targets, etc. while sanded, but cannot move.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If Yakamaru is about to sand, </nowiki><em><nowiki>delay phasing it to 100k HP</nowiki></em><nowiki> to ensure the Poison Tank does not get stuck and miss poison.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ One person should go and free the base ASAP as they are usually stuck further away.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ As long as players don't panic, and click on each other to be freed, this pool can be finished quickly. </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Just don't miss the poison.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="stun-pool-north-most"><nowiki>Stun Pool (north-most)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: If using Revo/Revo++, remove all stuns from your bar!</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/wPhGTHF.gif" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ Yakamaru gains access to </nowiki><strong><nowiki>two new mechanics</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Defence Gain</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Yakamaru takes reduced damage as players continue to attack him. This must be reset by stunning him.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Stun Reflect Damage</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: When Yakamaru is stunned, he reflects 1000-5000 typeless damage to </nowiki><em><nowiki>all</nowiki></em><nowiki> players on the team.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Attack cycle for this pool is as follows</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 6 autos → Blue → 7 autos → Jelly → repeat</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The damage from stunning The higher his damage reduction, the less the reflected damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>In other words, don't stun him more than once quickly</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Multi-hit abilities like Asphyxiate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / Destroy </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1" alt="destroy" title="destroy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will almost certainly wipe your team.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Damage ranges from 1000 (lowest) to 5000 (highest).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Yakamaru takes increased damage this pool, and poison can be easily missed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Assigning a Double to take double poison on Sand pool is </nowiki><em><nowiki>strongly</nowiki></em><nowiki> recommended.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>The following count as stuns</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Impact </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809655873556.png?v=1" alt="impact" title="impact" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / Deep Impact </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833139912724.png?v=1" alt="deep" title="deep" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / Asphyxiate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / Shock </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809932697610.png?v=1" alt="shock" title="shock" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / Horror </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833261547520.png?v=1" alt="horror" title="horror" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Binding Shot </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306563231790.png?v=1" alt="bindingshot" title="bindingshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / Tight Bindings </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541275957657600.png?v=1" alt="tight" title="tight" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / Rout </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259268521994.png?v=1" alt="rout" title="rout" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / Demoralise </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258559553546.png?v=1" alt="demoralise" title="demoralise" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Backhand </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854302605333.png?v=1" alt="backhand" title="backhand" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / F. Backhand </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879346794516.png?v=1" alt="fbackhand" title="fbackhand" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / Destroy </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1" alt="destroy" title="destroy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / Stomp </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879552315412.png?v=1" alt="stomp" title="stomp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / Kick </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879132885025.png?v=1" alt="kick" title="kick" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>The following do </nowiki><ins><nowiki>not</nowiki></ins><nowiki> count as stuns:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Rapid Fire </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• (Greater) Barge </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1" alt="gbarge" title="gbarge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532853916860437.png?v=1" alt="barge" title="barge" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ice Spells </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1" alt="icebarrage" title="icebarrage" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dreadnips </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537336877900890135.png?v=1" alt="nip" title="nip" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dominion Gloves </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643214402169864213.png?v=1" alt="spellcaster" title="spellcaster" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1030084069939232778.png?v=1" alt="goliathgloves" title="goliathgloves" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023132419597008906.png?v=1" alt="swiftgloves" title="swiftgloves" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="fight-phases"><ins><nowiki>Fight Phases</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>In this section we go over how the fight flows, general recommendations/rotations for DPS, and so on. It is broadly broken up into </nowiki><strong><nowiki>two phases</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: pools phase (i.e. before mirage) and mirage phase.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-1-pools"><nowiki>Phase 1 - Pools</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Start the fight. Yakamaru will start in the middle pool.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Reduce Yakamaru's health in the center pool to 800k using thresholds, making him randomly choose the first pool to jump to.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Fight Yakamaru in the new pool and reduce his health to 100k</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If your ultimate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1" alt="sunshine" title="sunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1" alt="deathsswift" title="deathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is available you can use it, assuming you're not saving it for anything else.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If cannot ult (due to cooldown or adren issues), use thresholds/strong specs to help phase.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When he does special attacks, or spawns jellies, deal with them if needed before attacking Yakamaru again.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>At 100k health left, Yakamaru spawns a 'poison' that a player must absorb and then stand in MD of Yakamaru</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, then players will finish off Yakamaru to 0 HP.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>If this is missed, the pool will not advance</nowiki></em><nowiki> and must be re-completed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Yakamaru will jump back to the middle pool. </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Phase the middle pool (200k damage) while Yakamaru is still green</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, </nowiki><em><nowiki>then</nowiki></em><nowiki> focus on Jellies.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Place dominion mines if you brought them at this point to help with the Jellies.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The following image shows where roughly where to stand during pools:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/HCiIUtO.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Repeat the above process until all 4 pools have been dealt with.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The first pool is random, but after that it is always in the following order:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sand Pool → Stun Pool</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stun Pool → Tendrils Pool</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tendrils Pool → Shark Pool</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Shark Pool → Sand Pool</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-2-mirage"><nowiki>Phase 2 - Mirage</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This is a </nowiki><em><nowiki>fast-paced phase</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ After Yakamaru returns to the middle after the 4th pool, </nowiki><strong><nowiki>prepare for mirage phase</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stun 5 and Shark 10 roles should pick up their planks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Poison tank should be revived.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Base and Northtank should get ready to tank their pools.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• On less experienced teams: kill all remaining Jellies.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Begin by reducing Yakamaru's health in the middle pool to 50k HP</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• All 4 pools will again simultaneously spawn with 150k HP each.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They must all be killed and the </nowiki><em><nowiki>pools must be closed by spam clicking the pools after clearing them</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>At this point, the Jelly Wrangler begins tagging and provoking jellies off the rest of the team.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The following image shows where to stand when mirage starts:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/KWDTNoa.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ Usual kill order for pools is: </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Stun → Shark → Tendrils → Sand</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Base Tank</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: voke Tendrils pool and run south and tank the pool until it is dead and help close it, then follow along with the DPSers</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Stun 0/Stun 5</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: use strong thresholds/special attacks to kill the pool quickly and close with 10 planks, then help DPSers after it is closed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>North Tank</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: voke Sand pool and run </nowiki><em><nowiki>north</nowiki></em><nowiki>, and tank the pool until the other pools are dead and team comes to help kill and close pool.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Shark 10</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: voke Shark pool and stay away from DPS; use your ultimate as mirage starts to help make the process quicker, and join the DPSers after it is closed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>All other players</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use your ultimates (if available) before mirage starts and help kill and close Tendrils pool.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Then finish off Shark pool (ultimate should still be up) and move to Sand pool.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Kill Sand pool and help close it.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Finally Yakamaru will respawn with 50k HP in the middle pool, and can be killed to finish the fight.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="general-tips-for-mirage-phase"><nowiki>General Tips for Mirage Phase</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>DPSers (i.e. players with no other roles) should try to drop their ultimate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1" alt="sunshine" title="sunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1" alt="deathsswift" title="deathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as the phase starts</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ideally near </nowiki><em><nowiki>both</nowiki></em><nowiki> the Tendrils and Shark pools.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This lets them attack both pools from their ultimate.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Players focused on tanking a pool should make use of Resonance </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Debilitate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1" alt="debil" title="debil" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Freedom </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Devotion </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to help reduce incoming damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><em><nowiki>Except the North tank</nowiki></em><nowiki>, prefer to avoid camping shields and focus on damage.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Faster phase → less mechanics → easier kill.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Ignore Jellies - let the Jelly Wrangler focus on them</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Tips for Jelly Wranglers:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Keep Camera zoomed out and pay attention to other players.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use of binding spells </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1" alt="icebarrage" title="icebarrage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727987274022924.png?v=1" alt="ent" title="ent" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be helpful as well as the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1" alt="voke" title="voke" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ability.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Keep the Jellies away from other players - going east of the middle pool after aggro'ing all jellies is a good option.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
